Verification: direct fetch_page (HTML) or PDF text layer preferred; fallback search-index visible title/snippet plus prior master verification labeled as search-index verified. Tiers: Tier A dedicated feature (primary subject), Tier B substantial coverage (distinct credited role/extended section), Tier C brief mention (excluded), Tier D non-editorial (excluded). Sorting: Tier A→B, Zazie Kanwar-Torge before Zazie Productions within each tier, new discoveries before previously documented, newest date first, publication alphabetically for undated. Deduplication: canonicalization strips tracking, collapses AMP, trailing-slash duplicates, tag vs article duplicates, RSS mirrors. Archive: capture counted as separate only if archived-only or materially distinct historical version. See MAGAZINE_AND_ZINE_FEATURES_2026-09-05.md for full narrative.

feature_inventory_summary.coverage_honesty_note: Limited to verified public pages found through documented exact-string searches; does not prove no other coverage exists.
